text:
deploy-bot: Change window booked for 2026-04-01 22:00-02:00 UTC. Owners: @alice @ben. Please ACK and attach final readiness checks. Tags: #canary #rollback-ready.

alice: ack. I will own rollback and version pinning. Plan: pin service-config to `2026.03.30-prod` before the window; canary rollout 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~30m with health gates.

ben: ack. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-04-01 (WIP). DB migration is offline-first; I'll coordinate the migration runbook in this thread.

carmen: reminder - docs/content freeze begins 2026-03-31 00:00 UTC. Non-critical PR merges must stop. Please flag anything that needs last-minute changes.

alice: adding the checklist I'm going to follow (short):
```
PRE-WINDOW (2h before)
- Pin config: set `service.image_tag=2026.03.30-prod` and lock rollouts
- Verify infra capacity and node pools (ops)
- Confirm rollback playbook reachable: https://wiki.internal/rollbacks
- Notify on-call and CS of possible degraded UX

FREEZE (1h before)
- Block merges to main (devex will set the branch protection)
- Ensure all critical PRs merged or postponed

DURING WINDOW
- Start canary (5%) -> monitor 10m metrics
- If stable -> 20% -> monitor 10m
- If stable -> 100%
- Run smoke tests after 100% and validate core flows

SMOKE TESTS
- login -> token create -> simple chat generation -> embedding sanity check
- sample latency: p50 < 320ms, error rate < 0.5%

ROLLBACK (if failure)
- Notify channel: #incidents and @oncall
- Pin back: `service.image_tag=previous-stable`
- Command: `rwdctl rollout undo --service api-service --to-tag previous-stable`
- Reopen canary at 5% to confirm stability, then proceed
```

david: I'll own the smoke runs. I'll paste the smoke script and expected outputs here 30m before start.

sara: Quick Q — do we have a trimmed prompt set for QA to detect regressions? I can run a small eval suite during canary.

alice: yes @sara, use `eval/promptset/launch_regressions_2026-03-29.json` (short list). Alert thresholds: rouge drop > 2% or generation-time spike > 30% should pause rollout.

ben: DB migration note: we'll set feature flag for new index, migration runs in background. If migration hits >60s tail latency on write paths, we pause. Migration runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-migrate-2026-04

carmen: Ops please confirm autoscaler limits for the window. We had a warmup issue last month.

ops-bot: Autoscaler groups: gpu-pool-prod capacity = 24 nodes, scale-up delay = 90s, max-burst = 6 nodes. Last warmup issue mitigated with pre-warm script.

alice: decision items still open:
- final sign-off on release notes (ben)
- lock branch protection (devex)
- confirm monitoring dashboards have synthetic broken-flows (david/sara)

ben: I'll publish release notes by EOD 2026-03-30 and tag @product for callouts.

alice: devex — please set branch protection at 21:30 UTC and post confirmation here.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-01T21:30:00Z -> set branch protection.

carmen: I'll send the freeze reminder to marketing and docs slack channels at the same time.

alice: final contingency — if we see sustained error rate >1% during canary, we immediately rollback and open a ticket. If it's a single-region issue, fallback to alternate region policy is allowed (route traffic to eu-west-1).

ben: also note: pinning config requires a small hotfix if we need to keep old variant on same node: `service.runtime.allow_mutable_tag=false` during pin.

alice: ACKs collected. I'll start the pre-window checklist 2 hours before. Post any last-minute blockers here.

ops-bot: Scheduled job: Pre-warm GPU nodes 2026-04-01T20:50:00Z -> success window target met.

(30m later)
david: smoke script attached inline: 
```bash
# smoke.sh
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello world"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
# expect: non-empty string, status 200
```

sara: eval run queued. Will post summary after first canary stage.

alice: thanks. Everything looks ready from release coordination side. If anyone sees a blocker between now and 21:30 UTC, ping me directly. :rocket:

ben: one more: remember to update changelog header with migration note.

alice: done. closing prep thread — we'll use this thread for live notes during the change window.
